      public static PublicGameUpdateDTO buildPublicGameState(Map<org.engine.contract.Contract, UUID> contractIdMap, org.engine.game.Move move, org.engine.game.state.GameState prevState, org.engine.game.state.GameState newState)
      Assembles the full PublicGameUpdateDTO to broadcast after a move transition. Called by GameService for every move, including bot moves.

    • detectCompletedPlayArea

      public static CompletedPlayAreaDTO detectCompletedPlayArea(org.engine.game.Move move, org.engine.game.state.GameState prevState, org.engine.game.state.GameState newState)
      Recovers the play area (trick or tableau) that was completed by move, if any.

      When a trick or Réussite tableau is completed, the engine immediately advances to the next state, which no longer contains the completed area. This method reconstructs it from prevState and the triggering move so the frontend can display it before it disappears.

      The result is embedded in PublicGameUpdateDTO and broadcast to all clients via STOMP after every move (see GameService).

      Parameters:
      move - the move just applied (may be null for synthetic/initial states)
      prevState - game state immediately before move was applied
      newState - game state immediately after move was applied
      Returns:
      a CompletedPlayAreaDTO.CompletedTrickDTO or CompletedPlayAreaDTO.CompletedTableauDTO if this move completed a play area, or null
